purpose: Owner-requested check that the saved Telnyx account can do everything calling needs, without buying a number or placing a call.
method: The installed workspace's saved key was decrypted in memory only (no file written, no key printed). Only GET requests, one short-lived WebRTC token, and deliberately invalid POSTs that Telnyx must reject were sent. Scripts were kept outside the repository.

results.observed: Voice API app active, webhooks to the shared Supabase relay, API v2, outbound voice profile attached
enabled, conversational traffic, destinations US and CA, no daily spend limit set
rep audio credential not expired, resource is a credential connection, SIP username matches saved setup
active, sip_uri_calling_preference internal, no outbound voice profile (correct for the rep leg)
code 10031 'No numbers found ... try best_effort=true'; the app treated this as an error and now treats it as an empty search
numbers available at $1.00 upfront and $1.00 monthly
validation error, not a permission error; nothing ordered
10004 missing parameter /to; not a permission error; nothing dialed
10038 'This feature is not permitted at this account level'; not used by the app, but shows the account is not at the highest verification level
authenticated handshake; closed without sending audio

conclusion: Calling, rep audio, speech-to-text, webhooks, number search and number ordering are all reachable with the saved key. A real order, a real call, machine detection and caller-name listing can only be proven with an owned number.
open_items: The account level blocks at least one feature. Third-party guides report Level 1 accounts cap outbound calling (about 10 calls per hour, 100 per day); confirm the level in the Telnyx portal and complete Level 2 verification before campaign volume.
No number is owned; buying or syncing one, the inbound test call and a live outbound call remain owner steps.
